parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, cylindrical in shape, and used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn on/off or adjust the water flow by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around its axis to control the internal valve mechanism.

parts.name: Frame (Body Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body or frame of the faucet, made of stainless steel, serving as the structural base connecting the spout and switches.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the faucet to the sink and water supply lines.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides support for other moving parts.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, curved in shape, and responsible for directing water flow.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the mixed water from the internal valve to the sink outlet.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally depending on the faucet design, but typically remains fixed vertically.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right switch handle of the faucet, made of stainless steel, similar to the left handle, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to adjust the water flow or temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or tilts around its axis to control the internal valve mechanism.
